scripts.dev:web: corepack pnpm --dir apps/web exec astro dev --background
scripts.stop:web: corepack pnpm --dir apps/web exec astro dev stop
scripts.status:web: corepack pnpm --dir apps/web exec astro dev status
scripts.cms:up: docker compose -f infra/local/docker-compose.yml up -d database wordpress
scripts.cms:seed: docker compose -f infra/local/docker-compose.yml --profile tools run --rm wpcli direpair seed-demo
scripts.cms:logs: docker compose -f infra/local/docker-compose.yml logs --tail 100 wordpress database
scripts.cms:stop: docker compose -f infra/local/docker-compose.yml stop wordpress database
